C0562.title: Courier Sentenced to 2 Years 10 Months for Illegally Profiting 380,000 Yuan Through Gift Scam
C0562.summary: A courier in Beijing exploited an e-commerce platform vulnerability over two years by refusing delivery of main products while keeping over 800 free gifts, which he then resold for an illegal profit of 380,000 yuan. The court convicted him of fraud and sentenced him to 2 years and 10 months in prison.

references.title: Procuratorate Report: Courier Convicted for Keeping Promotional Gifts After False Orders
